entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought last week.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your order number, please?

Thank you. I see the order for the Velo-Carbon 8 cycling shoes, delivered three days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's the fit. I took them on one ride, and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I think the stiffness is just wrong for my foot shape, and where the cleats are positioned feels awkward.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Since it's a fit issue and you're well within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund is good. But I paid for expedited shipping to get them here, and now I have to go through the hassle of packing them up and sending them back. Would you be able to add a small store credit or a 15% discount code to my account for the inconvenience?

I understand your point about the shipping and the inconvenience. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on returns due to fit, as it's not a product defect, I want to make sure you find the right gear. What I can do is waive any return shipping fees and send you a pre-paid label right now. I'd also be happy to walk you through some of our other models that have a more flexible heel cup, which might prevent those blisters in the future.
So no discount code at all? I'm going to have to place a whole new order.

I'm afraid I can't issue a discount code for this return, but ensuring you don't pay for the return shipping is the best I can offer. Once we process the refund, the full amount for the cycling shoes will be back in your account, and you can apply that to a new pair that's a better match for you.
Alright, that's fair enough. Free return shipping works. Please go ahead and send me the label.

Excellent. I've just initiated the return process and emailed the pre-paid shipping label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a more comfortable pair of shoes soon. Have a great day.
